name: SLOMAN NEPTUN Schiffahrts-Aktiengesellschaft
summary: SLOMAN NEPTUN Schiffahrts-Aktiengesellschaft operates as a shipping company worldwide. The company transports gas, oil, and chemical products. It operates a fleet of gas tankers, oil/chemical tankers, and dry cargo vessels, as well as provides liner services through multipurpose vessels. The company was formerly known as Dampfschifffahrts-Gesellschaft 'Neptun', Bremen, Actien-Gesellschaft and changed its name to SLOMAN NEPTUN Schiffahrts-Aktiengesellschaft in 1973. The company was founded in 1873 and is headquartered in Bremen, Germany. SLOMAN NEPTUN Schiffahrts-Aktiengesellschaft is a subsidiary of Rob. M. Sloman & Co.
